adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, imported HTML is saved with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for that method (skipping the normal cooking/rendering pipeline). The embed view then renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>` (best.html.erb), so the HTML is effectively unsanitized. `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls` only rewrites `href`/`src` values starting with `'/'` and does not validate or restrict URI schemes, so protocol-relative (`//...`), `data:`, `javascript:`, etc. pass through unchanged into rendered HTML. That is a concrete security/correctness defect exposed by this diff.
